nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Embracing experiences over possessions_qna_000
nodes.label: Psychology
nodes.question: What does the ELM propose about attitudes formed through elaboration?
nodes.answer: The ELM suggests that attitudes are more likely to be stable when they are formed through greater elaboration, meaning when individuals have thought more deeply about them.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Embracing experiences over possessions_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What are some reasons why people may prefer renting over owning?
nodes.answer: Some reasons people may prefer renting over owning include avoiding the financial burden of purchasing an item outright, having access to a variety of items without the commitment of ownership, and the convenience of not having to worry about maintenance or storage.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Embracing experiences over possessions_qna_002
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What aspects beyond material features do ordinary objects touch on?
nodes.answer: Ordinary objects touch on aspects such as memories, notions of time and space, origins, history, and a set of beliefs embedded within cultural systems, representing subjectivity by carrying and communicating transient significance through functionalities and aesthetics.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Embracing experiences over possessions_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and Tech
nodes.question: In what way do imaginative materialities help uncover new understandings of future values?
nodes.answer: Imaginative materialities enable us to uncover new understandings of future values by utilizing cultural information from our pasts and presents. This process allows for the exploration of societal values that transcend time and contribute to the creation of symbolic meanings embedded in objects.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Embracing experiences over possessions_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Miller (2009) emphasizes the significance of material possessions in our lives. How does our attachment to stuff impact our identity and social status?
nodes.answer: Miller (2009) explores how our attachment to material possessions affects identity and social status.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Embracing experiences over possessions_qna_005
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What type of benefits did young consumers explore a positive value attitude relationship for, according to McNeil and Venter (2019)?
nodes.answer: According to McNeil and Venter (2019), young consumers explored a positive value attitude relationship for utilitarian and hedonistic benefits.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Embracing experiences over possessions_qna_006
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is modern consumption often described as hedonic according to Campbell (2005)?
nodes.answer: Campbell argues that modern consumption is often hedonic because it caters more to emotions and pleasure than satisfying needs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Embracing experiences over possessions_qna_007
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What drives overconsumption according to Harris et al. (2015) in relation to re-wearing clothes?
nodes.answer: Harris et al. (2015) suggest that overconsumption is driven by social pressures to avoid being seen re-wearing clothes, which aligns with the attitudes observed in Gen Z.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Embracing experiences over possessions_qna_008
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How does the mindset of wanting to own items affect the adoption of rental schemes?
nodes.answer: The mindset of wanting to own items may hinder the adoption of rental schemes as people may perceive owning as a status symbol, preventing them from exploring rental options.
